name: Nurumaru
tagline: Big round eyes. Wonderfully odd expressions.
description: A soft cream-colored friend with huge eyes and a tiny tongue. From happy dances to exhausted flops, Nurumaru has a face for everyday feelings.

name: Monyon
tagline: Floppy ears, endless charm.
description: A pale lavender friend with delightfully mismatched floppy ears. Sweet bows, sleepy poses, and warm little greetings make Monyon hard to resist.

name: Pururi
tagline: A little drop of personality.
description: An aqua-blue friend with a curled teardrop head. Pururi puts tiny arms and legs into big, expressive greetings and surprised reactions.

name: Mamepo
tagline: Small bean. Big feelings.
description: A bright green bean-shaped friend with two little leaves. Mamepo brings cheerful thanks and encouragement to everyday conversations.

name: Potepi
tagline: Tiny wings, plenty of enthusiasm.
description: A round yellow chick-like friend with an orange beak and feet. Potepi runs, flaps, and cheers with its whole little body.

name: Munitake
tagline: A pink mushroom with a floppy cap.
description: A mushroom-shaped friend peeking out from beneath a big pink cap. Munitake brings a playful touch to greetings and well-earned breaks.

name: Nyoropo
tagline: Long body, lively reactions.
description: A pale orange friend that bends and stretches to match its mood. Nyoropo adds a little silliness to everyday replies.

name: Petaron
tagline: Flat out, and proud of it.
description: A wide, flat blue-gray friend with long dangling arms. Petaron is perfectly at home lounging around and enjoying a quiet break.

name: Suimochi
tagline: Little suction cups. Lots of heart.
description: A soft green friend with pink suction cups on its short arms and legs. Suimochi shares thanks and caring words in its own unusual way.

name: Mimyon
tagline: Long ears that join every gesture.
description: A lavender friend with long pink-lined ears. Whether waving hello or celebrating, Mimyon never keeps its feelings still.

name: Mokupu
tagline: A little yellow cloud of kindness.
description: A cloud-shaped friend made of soft yellow bumps. Mokupu adds a warm, fluffy touch to thank-yous and everyday encouragement.

name: Tayuri
tagline: A droopy little daydreamer.
description: A teal friend with a long, drooping teardrop head and round belly. Tayuri knows how to settle into a cozy break.

name: Koromu
tagline: Taking life one spiral at a time.
description: A cream-colored snail-like friend with a green spiral shell. Koromu is always ready with a greeting, a thank-you, or a thoughtful pause.

name: Peromu
tagline: A tongue with a life of its own.
description: A pink friend with a long, ribbon-like tongue. Peromu has an unusual twist for every mood, especially when snacks are involved.

name: Uneri
tagline: Bending with every feeling.
description: A soft green friend that curls, stretches, and wiggles to show its mood. Uneri understands tired days and the joy of taking it easy.

name: Hoppero
tagline: Cheeks full of personality.
description: A round peach-colored friend with enormous cheeks. Hoppero lights up at compliments and anything delicious.
traits: ほっぺを抱えるポーズ

name: Hidapo
tagline: A little stretch goes a long way.
description: A lavender friend with a body of soft horizontal folds. Hidapo shrinks down or stretches tall to express every change of mood.

name: Tsuburi
tagline: Tiny bumps. Big joy.
description: A pale purple friend with a grape-like cluster of rounded bumps. Tsuburi celebrates, thanks, and curls up with equal enthusiasm.

name: Pirone
tagline: Ribbon-like ears, ready to listen.
description: A pale yellow friend whose long ears reach right down to its feet. Pirone spreads, curls, and folds them through every conversation.

name: Pokome
tagline: A big belly and an even bigger heart.
description: An aqua-green friend with an oversized round tummy and tiny limbs. Pokome loves celebrating and being the one you can count on.

name: Subero
tagline: Sliding through everyday life.
description: A flat pink friend with wide arms and a curled tail. Subero slides into your chat with quiet support and invitations to take a break.

name: Kurune
tagline: Curled ears and a cheerful little heart.
description: A pink friend with tightly curled ears. Kurune shares greetings, gratitude, and everyday feelings with a playful twist.

name: Noperu
tagline: Long arms for big feelings.
description: A pale blue-purple friend with wonderfully long, paddle-shaped arms. Noperu reaches out with thanks, greetings, and encouragement.

name: Poyosuke
tagline: A soft little star with plenty of energy.
description: A light green star-shaped friend. Poyosuke turns greetings, gratitude, and happy moments into big, bouncy reactions.

name: Fuwarimo
tagline: A fluttery hello for your day.
description: A cream-colored friend with a frilly hem. Fuwarimo adds a gentle flutter to greetings, thanks, and thoughtful little messages.

name: Toronbo
tagline: Some days, even motivation melts.
description: A pudding-like friend with an expressive, wobbly body. Toronbo gets both energetic days and days when everything feels a little melty.

name: Hasamoro
tagline: A clothes peg with a personality.
description: A clothes-peg-shaped friend with an unmistakable silhouette. Hasamoro turns everyday replies into funny, full-body gestures.

name: Fukuppe
tagline: A little pouch packed with feelings.
description: A round drawstring-pouch friend. Fukuppe bundles up gratitude, excitement, and everyday thoughts into lovable reactions.

name: Negomochi
tagline: Your friend for low-energy days.
description: A mochi-pillow-like friend who loves a good flop. Negomochi is there for sleepy replies, gentle support, and occasional bursts of joy.

name: Makurimo
tagline: Rolled up, ready to react.
description: A friend shaped like a curled towel. Makurimo unfolds big reactions for the little moments in everyday life.

name: Chamoppe
tagline: A little tea break with a friendly face.
description: A tea-bag-shaped friend with a tiny swinging tag. Chamoppe brings easygoing greetings and cozy replies to your conversations.

name: Pokurino
tagline: A happy little spin on your day.
description: A round spinning-top friend. When Pokurino's feelings get going, the reactions start spinning too.

name: Merupoko
tagline: Delivering feelings, one face at a time.
description: A letter-shaped friend with expressive eyes and poses. Merupoko helps deliver the feelings that are hard to put into words.

name: Wappuru
tagline: Round, with a little hole and lots of charm.
description: A round friend with a small hole in its body. Wappuru reacts with its whole self on both great days and gloriously clumsy ones.

name: Takemoni
tagline: A tiny bamboo shoot with a lot to say.
description: A rounded bamboo-shoot friend with a layered body. Takemoni sways through friendly greetings and funny little reactions.

name: Posune
tagline: Stamping a little feeling into every reply.
description: A rubber-stamp-shaped friend. Posune delivers gratitude, greetings, and honest little thoughts with a satisfying little pop.

name: Kushupo
tagline: Every feeling, from head to toe.
description: A friend who stretches tall and scrunches small. Kushupo puts its whole body into happy moments, tired days, and everything in between.

name: Kasamon
tagline: Opening up, rain or shine.
description: A mint-green umbrella friend. Kasamon dashes, flops, and opens up big feelings on both rainy and sunny days.

name: Jigupo
tagline: Some days click. Some days don't.
description: A puzzle-piece friend who looks proud when things fit and takes a break when they don't. Jigupo is a little awkward and very lovable.

name: Kutsunyo
tagline: One lonely sock. Still in a good mood.
description: A sock-shaped friend who bends, bounces, and gets cozy. Kutsunyo is all about easygoing replies and taking the pressure off.

name: Pitagon
tagline: Sticking by your side.
description: A suction-cup-shaped friend with big reactions. Pitagon plants itself firmly beside you, ready to respond with energy and warmth.

name: Togepoko
tagline: Spiky outside. Soft-hearted inside.
description: A soft-spiked little friend who likes to play the villain. Behind the mischievous chuckle, Togepoko is surprisingly thoughtful.

name: Warubane
tagline: Big wings. Secretly your biggest fan.
description: A tiny bat friend with enormous wings and a bossy streak. Warubane may act important, but it always has a quiet cheer for a friend.

name: Dokumoko
tagline: Brewing up a little happiness.
description: A mysterious cauldron friend topped with fluffy green bubbles. Dokumoko mixes up smiles and energy, even when the recipe goes wrong.

name: Tonoguro
tagline: A tiny boss with a thoughtful side.
description: A little castle-tower friend with a dramatic cape. Tonoguro sounds grand, but would happily invite you to sit down for tea.

name: Magunyo
tagline: Drawn to the little things you love.
description: A red magnet friend with a purple cape and big gestures. Magunyo pulls a little energy and sparkle into everyday chats.

name: Riboruru
tagline: A twist, a twirl, a lighter mood.
description: A mint-colored ribbon-bow friend with long ribbon tails for legs. Riboruru runs, leaps, and flourishes through every feeling.

name: Sunamogu
tagline: No rush. That's the Sunamogu way.
description: An hourglass friend with flowing golden sand. Sunamogu takes a breath even on busy days, then reacts with its whole little body.

name: Chakkoro
tagline: A zip of energy in every reply.
description: A yellow pouch friend with a grinning zipper mouth. Chakkoro bends, bounces, and delivers upbeat replies and encouragement.

name: Senpuku
tagline: One fan. A whole lot of drama.
description: A folding-fan friend with a flair for theatrical gestures. Senpuku makes greetings, gratitude, and tea breaks feel like little performances.

name: Ketoron
tagline: All tangled up? Keep it light.
description: A mint-green yarn-ball friend with a curled yarn tail. Ketoron sometimes overthinks things, but untangling them is worth celebrating.

name: Dongunyo
tagline: A tiny acorn with a big heart.
description: An acorn friend proud of its oversized cap. Dongunyo rolls to the rescue and volunteers to be your biggest cheerleader.

name: Yakapu
tagline: When feelings bubble up, put the kettle on.
description: A blue kettle friend who puffs with excitement. Yakapu can be impatient, but always has a calming cup of tea to offer.
